detail: Policy subscribed 31 May 2019, subscriber Vincent Jeanbrun. Declared to HATVP.

HATVP declaration of patrimony records no financial instruments (heading 4: Neant) and no unlisted securities (heading 3: Neant). He holds ordinary bank and savings accounts only (Societe Generale, BNP Paribas, Boursobank, Bourse Direct), the largest being a 140,000 EUR savings account and a 24,128 EUR Livret A.
